tools.name: DeepSeek Harness
tools.category: AI 编码代理 / AI Coding Agents
tools._comment: DeepSeek's official agent harness ('Everything is a Plugin'). The repo was created 2026-08-13 and shipped NO GitHub releases yet, so check_updates reports 'no releases' (an expected ERR) until the first tag lands — once it does, the baseline run records it and detection works normally. Drop this note / tune exclude_prerelease once releases exist.

tools.name: Warp
tools._comment: Warp's real releases use date-based tags like v0.2026.06.09.19.54.dev_00 and are flagged prerelease, so we must NOT set exclude_prerelease. The tag_pattern whitelists this scheme to skip stray build-metadata tags (e.g. tui-screenshots-app5029) that ship mis-flagged as stable.

tools.name: Windows 11
tools._comment: Tracks the latest cumulative update build/KB for the configured Windows 11 version (25H2 is the current production release for most users as of mid-2026). Change win_version to 24H2 or 26H1 to track a different channel. The 'version' recorded is the OS build number (e.g. 26200.8973); detection compares builds, so a new monthly update surfaces as 'new'.

tools.name: macOS Tahoe
tools._comment: Tracks the latest GA point release of macOS Tahoe (26.x) from Apple's official 'What's new' page. The page lists versions newest-first as headings; the regex grabs the first (newest) match. macOS 27 Golden Gate is still in beta (fall 2026) and lives on a separate page, so it is excluded. When 27 goes GA, switch this entry to the macOS 27 'What's new' page and update version_regex to 'macOS 27 (\d+\.\d+(?:\.\d+)?)'. No release date is available from this source.
